trace.question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
trace.evidence: account created in the year 2011 refers to year(CreationDate) = 2011

attempts.sql:
SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'
